title: trailboss --json task templates
description: The brief templates `task add --brief-template <name>` can use: each `.md` file in `.trailboss/briefs/` at the top of the repository the folder is in, by name. A template is text: each brief goes where it says `{{brief}}`, the rest is copied as is. Nothing in it is run. Empty when there are none.

name.description: What `--brief-template` takes: the file's name without `.md`.

title.description: Its first line that isn't empty, without a Markdown heading's `#`.

problem.description: Why `task add` would refuse it (a name it doesn't take, no `{{brief}}`); null when it's fine.
